answer: The three words are derived from a 203 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. Because the garden nonce is published only after close, the tide audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate pigment derivation per key. That is 16 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
